# Chrome Pro Contributors

Chrome Pro is built in public. Every useful contribution matters.

## Ways to contribute

- Report reproducible bugs
- Improve accessibility
- Improve performance
- Add tests
- Improve documentation
- Improve UI/UX
- Build Electron/Chromium features
- Improve search resilience
- Review pull requests
- Help other users in Discussions

## Recognition

Contributors are recognized through merged pull requests, release notes, and the project's contributor history. Please use your GitHub account when opening pull requests so contributions can be attributed correctly.

## Start here

Look for issues labeled `good first issue`, `help wanted`, `documentation`, `accessibility`, or `testing`.
